class Node:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.right = None
        self.data = val
        self.left = None

def convertToDLL(root):
    if not root:
        return None, None
    
    if not root.left and not root.right:
        return root, root
    
    head_left, tail_left = convertToDLL(root.left)
    head_right, tail_right = convertToDLL(root.right)
    
    if tail_left:
        tail_left.right = root
        root.left = tail_left
    
    if head_right:
        root.right = head_right
        head_right.left = root
    
    root.left = root.right = None
    
    head = head_left if head_left else root
    tail = tail_right if tail_right else root
    
    return head, tail

def inorderTraversal(root):
    if not root:
        return []
    return inorderTraversal(root.left) + [root.data] + inorderTraversal(root.right)

def dllTraversal(head, reverse=False):
    result = []
    current = head if not reverse else head.right
    while current:
        result.append(current.data)
        current = current.right if not reverse else current.left
    return result

def buildTree(indexes, index=1):
    if index > len(indexes) or indexes[index-1] == -1:
        return None
    node = Node(indexes[index-1])
    node.left = buildTree(indexes, 2*index)
    node.right = buildTree(indexes, 2*index+1)
    return node

import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
indexes = list(map(int, input))
root = buildTree(indexes)

dll_head, _ = convertToDLL(root)
modified_tree_inorder = inorderTraversal(root)
dll_forward = dllTraversal(dll_head)
dll_backward = dllTraversal(dll_head, reverse=True)

print(" ".join(map(str, modified_tree_inorder)))
print(" <-> ".join(map(str, dll_forward)))
print(" <-> ".join(map(str, dll_backward)))
